notes: SOURCE: sales-pitch voice of an unnamed renovation team; 'newly renovated house'; two floors, a pretty big attic, two bedrooms, two bathrooms; used to be 'real bad', a 'torture labyrinth'; Death Rat infestation said to be exterminated; nobody lives here yet, hard to sell because of its reputation; AC installed but 'in shambles'; anyone who means well may stay; exit near the old oak in the backyard, return allowed. ADAPTATION: the house plan (hall and stair; living room, open kitchen/dining; laundry, bathroom 1, den mid-paint; bedroom 1, bathroom 2, bedroom 2, bonus room with a steep attic stair; walkable attic under a 40-degree gable), the staged furniture, the fenced lot with a chained front gate (the page names only the oak exit, so the gate is a diegetic limit), woods and late-afternoon haze round the lot, a FOR SALE sign; small wrongness under the fresh paint (a door under the stair painted shut that breathes cold stone air, snap traps and bait boxes along the attic eaves, a rare scratching that may be the house settling); the AC mechanic (thermostat -> rattle -> breaker trips and the house lights die -> reset at the laundry panel; fails the same way every time) dramatises 'in shambles'. Lighting, sound, temperature and materials are not stated by the page; ordinary house tone, wind and evening insects. No labyrinth is walkable and no rats appear (canon traps).
